title: Fix tiny Linux MMC runtime DMA support
description: Tiny BBB boots to initramfs but Linux MMC runtime repeatedly reports mmc0 timeout and error -110. The SD slot DTS declares EDMA channels, while the tiny kernel config lacks DMA engine/EDMA support. Add the minimal AM335x DMA support needed for clean SD/MMC runtime and verify generated config.
notes: Implemented tiny kernel hw.cfg DMA/EDMA fragment and verified make yocto-build YOCTO_IMAGE=core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs succeeds. Generated config has MMC_SDHCI_EXTERNAL_DMA=y, DMADEVICES=y, DMA_ENGINE=y, DMA_OF=y, DMA_VIRTUAL_CHANNELS=y, TI_EDMA=y, TI_DMA_CROSSBAR=y; DMA_OMAP remains off because AM335x SD/eMMC DTS uses &edma. Pending hardware validation: flash SD and confirm UART log uses External DMA and no mmc0 -110.
close_reason: Verified on BBB UART: EDMA driver loads, mmc0 uses External DMA, SDHC card enumerates as mmcblk0 with p1, and the previous mmc0 -110 timeout is gone in the provided boot log.

title: Tune SD Yocto image for UART-only debug baseline
description: Apply the approved first-cycle image tuning in the active Yocto build config only: keep UART login, keep debug-tweaks, add approved minimal UART debug toolkit, do not add SSH, do not touch DT/kernel/U-Boot, and verify the rebuilt SD image still boots to UART shell.

title: Fix PreCompact hook JSON output
description: Repo-local .codex/hooks.json still runs raw bd prime on PreCompact. Current Codex expects structured JSON for PreCompact hooks, so compacting can fail similarly to the SessionStart issue. Replace the raw output with a valid PreCompact JSON wrapper while preserving bd prime context.

title: Fix SessionStart hook JSON output
description: Repo-local .codex/hooks.json currently runs raw bd prime on SessionStart. Current Codex expects SessionStart hooks to emit structured JSON, so startup shows 'hook returned invalid session start JSON output'. Replace raw output with a wrapper that returns valid SessionStart JSON while preserving bd prime context.

title: Fix empty YOCTO_IMAGE inside builder container
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

make yocto-build currently reaches bitbake with an empty target, producing ERROR: Nothing PROVIDES ''. The Makefile exports YOCTO_IMAGE on the host side, but the builder container command relies on YOCTO_IMAGE being present inside the container environment. Fix the environment propagation so yocto-build passes the intended image target into the container runtime.

Acceptance criteria:
- builder container receives YOCTO_IMAGE for yocto-build invocations
- make yocto-build no longer fails with Nothing PROVIDES ''
- focused verification confirms the intended image name is visible inside the container before invoking bitbake

title: Add missing Yocto host tools to builder image
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

make yocto-build currently fails during Yocto hosttools validation because the builder image is missing bunzip2, bzip2, g++, lz4c, patch, pzstd, unzstd, and zstd. Update the Docker builder image with the required host tools and verify the builder container exposes them in PATH.

Acceptance criteria:
- docker/Dockerfile installs the missing Yocto host tools reported by make yocto-build
- builder image rebuilds successfully
- a focused runtime check confirms the required binaries are available in PATH inside the builder container
- docs stay accurate if image contract meaningfully changes

title: Fix missing Yocto env vars inside builder container
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

make yocto-init fails after poky is cloned because the builder container only receives PROJECT_STORAGE_ROOT and WORKSPACE_NAME. The Yocto helper targets use YOCTO_* variables inside the container command, so the compose service must export container-side Yocto paths rooted at /storage.

Acceptance criteria:
- builder container exports container-side YOCTO_* env vars
- make yocto-init succeeds once poky exists, instead of failing to source oe-init-build-env from an empty directory
- docs/runtime contract stay accurate

title: Implement Docker-only phase 1 builder workflow
description: Add Docker phase 1 builder infrastructure for beaglebone-optimal with compose-based runtime contract, required storage-root config, public Make targets, and verification workflow.

title: Investigate tiny MMC pbias and vqmmc supply warnings
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warnings from sdhci-omap: supply pbias not found, using dummy regulator and supply vqmmc not found, using dummy regulator. Determine exact driver source, DTS binding expectations, AM335x/BBB hardware model, impact on SD-only and future eMMC flows, and whether a safe patch exists before changing code.
notes: pbias portion resolved: added Yocto kernel patch for sdhci-omap capability probing to use regulator_get_optional() instead of regulator_get(). Full make yocto-build YOCTO_IMAGE=core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs passed. User boot log confirms pbias and vqmmc dummy-regulator warnings are absent, while mmc0 still enumerates as high speed SDHC.
close_reason: Resolved vqmmc via fixed 3.3V IO rail DT modeling and pbias via optional regulator lookup in sdhci-omap capability probing; build and board boot log verified.

title: Disable unused TPS65217 backlight child in tiny DTS
description: Tiny BBB boot logs show tps65217-bl: Failed to locate of_node [id: -1]. Investigation found backlight is unused in UART+SD tiny flow and CONFIG_BACKLIGHT_CLASS_DEVICE is disabled. Add an explicit disabled TPS65217 backlight child node in the tiny DTS so the MFD core can skip this unused cell without changing PMIC/regulator support.
close_reason: Added a disabled TPS65217 backlight child node to the tiny DTS only. Verified Yocto tiny image build succeeded and deployed DTB contains backlight compatible ti,tps65217-bl with status disabled under tps@24. PMIC/regulator support remains unchanged.

title: Investigate TPS65217 MFD of_node warnings
description: Investigate BBB tiny Linux boot warnings: tps65217-pmic: Failed to locate of_node [id: -1] and tps65217-bl: Failed to locate of_node [id: -1]. Determine exact source, DTS relationship, runtime impact, and whether a fix is safe before changing code.
close_reason: Investigated TPS65217 MFD of_node warnings. Root cause is MFD child cells tps65217-pmic and tps65217-bl having of_compatible values without matching child nodes in BBB DTB. Regulator support still uses parent tps node plus regulators container; backlight is not enabled in tiny kernel config. Recommendation: do not patch now; treat as non-functional boot-log noise unless enabling backlight/charger/powerbutton features later.

title: Silence invalid MMC card-detect debounce on tiny BBB DTS
description: Tiny BBB boot logs show omap_gpio 44e07000.gpio: Could not set line 6 debounce to 200000 microseconds (-22). Kernel source shows MMC defaults cd-debounce-delay-ms to 200ms when absent, then calls gpiod_set_debounce for the cd-gpios line. The tiny DTS should explicitly set cd-debounce-delay-ms to 0 for mmc1 so card-detect remains configured without requesting unsupported hardware debounce.
close_reason: Implemented tiny DTS override cd-debounce-delay-ms=<0> for mmc1. Verified Yocto tiny image build succeeded and deployed DTB contains cd-debounce-delay-ms = 0 with cd-gpios preserved.

title: Disable tiny U-Boot watchdog log
description: Tiny U-Boot Phase 1 should be MMC-only and serial-only with minimal boot noise. U-Boot proper still auto-starts the OMAP watchdog and prints WDT: Started even though SPL WDT and CMD_WDT are off. Disable the U-Boot watchdog surface only for beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny while preserving extlinux boot behavior.
notes: Approved decision: disable U-Boot proper watchdog entirely for beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny. Patched tiny-deterministic.cfg to unset WATCHDOG, WATCHDOG_AUTOSTART, WDT, and WDT_OMAP3; updated docs/boot-contract.md to include U-Boot watchdog servicing in tiny removed surface. Yocto tiny build passes; generated .config has WATCHDOG/WDT disabled. Pending UART proof after flashing rebuilt artifacts.
close_reason: Fresh UART proof shows tiny U-Boot no longer starts or logs U-Boot watchdog servicing; boot continues through /extlinux/extlinux.conf, /zImage, and the tiny DTB.

title: Disable tiny U-Boot watchdog log
description: Tiny U-Boot already boots serial/MMC-only and no longer needs U-Boot watchdog runtime servicing in Phase 1. The remaining WDT: Started line adds non-essential boot noise, so disable watchdog only for beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny while preserving bootcmd/extlinux behavior.

title: Clean up tiny U-Boot network and USB gadget boot noise
description: Fix only the approved beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny U-Boot cleanup: make tiny U-Boot MMC-only and serial-only while preserving extlinux.conf as Linux payload source of truth. Do not touch Linux kernel config, tiny DTS, baseline path, mmc0 -110, or eMMC flow.
notes: Fresh UART after ARCH_MISC_INIT fix now reaches autoboot, but bootcmd passed relative extlinux/extlinux.conf to sysboot. U-Boot pxe_setup_ctx derives bootdir from bootfile, so sysboot tried extlinux/extlinux/extlinux.conf and failed. Changed tiny bootcmd to pass absolute /extlinux/extlinux.conf. Yocto tiny build passes; generated .config has absolute path, ARCH_MISC_INIT off, NET/USB/EFI off. Pending SD flash/UART proof.
close_reason: Fresh UART proof shows tiny U-Boot MMC/extlinux boot works and removed noise is absent: no ethaddr/Net/RNDIS/usb_ether, no initcall failure, no bad extlinux path, and no U-Boot WDT log.

title: Document rtk-first shell rule in AGENTS
description: Add an AGENTS.md rule that shell commands should use the rtk wrapper whenever possible, and only fall back to raw commands when rtk is unavailable or would break required behavior.

title: Strengthen AGENTS rule for generated Yocto patches
description: Add a stricter AGENTS.md rule that forbids hand-writing Yocto/OpenEmbedded patch files when the underlying source can be modified and exported with git format-patch or devtool finish.

title: Document Yocto patch generation rule in AGENTS
description: Add a repo-level AGENTS.md rule that Yocto/OpenEmbedded patch files must be generated from source changes with git format-patch or devtool finish, not hand-written manually, unless a patch is intentionally tiny and no generated source exists.

title: Implement Phase 1 tiny Yocto foundation
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done\n\nImplement the locked Phase 1 tiny Yocto foundation on branch feat/tiny-yocto-foundation. This includes the public contract surface, custom tiny layer/machine/distro/image, sd-flash-tiny workflow, and repo-side proof scaffolding required before hardware boot proof. Follow tmp/docs/tiny-yocto-phase-1-lock.md exactly and keep baseline and tiny paths side by side.
notes: Locked canonical tiny naming map into tmp/docs: machine=beaglebone-black-optimal-tiny, distro=optimal-tiny, image=core-image-optimal-tiny-initramfs, DT root=am335x-boneblack-optimal-tiny. Added all-or-nothing rename and no-alias rules across structure/phase1/phase2 docs.

title: Document tiny Yocto phase 1 and phase 2 locked decisions
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done\n\nCreate two repo-local temporary design lock documents under tmp/docs/ that capture the approved tiny Yocto foundation decisions. One document should define the exact phase 1 contract and acceptance criteria for the tiny foundation workstream. The second should define phase 2 follow-on trimming and optimization work that is intentionally out of scope for phase 1. The docs should be explicit enough to guide implementation without reopening major design choices.

title: Update Yocto local.conf example for UART debug baseline
description: Reflect the approved UART-only debug baseline in yocto/conf/local.conf.example so future build dirs inherit the same serial console and minimal debug tool guidance.

title: Rewrite AGENTS.md as high-level repo guide
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done: AGENTS.md currently duplicates operational detail and is brittle. Replace it with a stable, high-level guide that helps AI coding assistants orient quickly, understand source-of-truth files, and follow repo workflow without needing frequent updates.

title: Add Yocto bblayers.conf example and document manual apply flow
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

The repo already provides yocto-init, yocto-build, and a project local.conf example, but the repeatable Yocto setup is still missing a committed bblayers.conf.example. Add the example file and update the workflow documentation so users manually copy both example files into the build directory after oe-init-build-env.

Acceptance criteria:
- repo includes yocto/conf/bblayers.conf.example
- file uses the minimal layer stack and relative paths
- yocto-init messaging and runbooks mention both example files without auto-copying them
- changes stay aligned with the fail-fast, user-managed conf workflow

title: Add Yocto init/build targets with project local.conf example
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

The repo now standardizes Yocto storage under PROJECT_STORAGE_ROOT, but users still have to manually remember the init/build sequence and project-specific local.conf settings. Add make targets that prepare the Yocto workspace without mutating conf/local.conf automatically, and commit a project local.conf example file for manual copy/append after oe-init-build-env.

Acceptance criteria:
- Make exposes yocto-init and yocto-build targets
- yocto-init prepares storage and validates required poky checkout location without editing conf/local.conf
- repo includes a project local.conf example file with MACHINE, DL_DIR, and SSTATE_DIR guidance
- runbooks document the manual copy/append flow and the new make targets

title: Add Yocto storage path variables derived from PROJECT_STORAGE_ROOT
description:
Why this issue exists and what needs to be done

The repo already standardizes heavy Docker builder data under PROJECT_STORAGE_ROOT, but Yocto path conventions are only implicit in docs and shell usage. Add derived Yocto storage variables and document the layout so Yocto build, sources, downloads, and sstate all live under the same host storage root.

Acceptance criteria:
- local.mk/example and/or Makefile expose derived Yocto storage variables from PROJECT_STORAGE_ROOT
- storage preparation creates the Yocto sources directory in the shared workspace layout
- runbooks document the Yocto layout and how to point oe-init-build-env, DL_DIR, and SSTATE_DIR into /storage
- changes stay scoped to storage conventions and docs

title: Simplify Docker user override contract
description: Replace HOST_UID/HOST_GID public contract with a single optional DOCKER_USER override, validate its format, and sync README plus runbooks.

title: Generate Understand Anything knowledge graph
description: Run the understand-anything skill for the current beaglebone-optimal checkout and save the generated knowledge graph artifacts under .understand-anything/.

title: Polish builder shell identity for host-mapped UID/GID
description: The Docker phase 1 builder shell works, but interactive bash shows an unmapped UID/GID prompt (for example: I have no name!). Investigate a portable way to improve shell UX without hardcoding local users or adding heavy runtime indirection.
